description: A field-staff beneficiary visit log with inconsistent village case/spacing, duplicate Visit IDs, blank separators and mixed INR cells.

questions.question: Normalise village names by trimming outer whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace and comparing case-insensitively; deduplicate Visit ID by keeping its first spreadsheet occurrence. What is the total number of people reached (women + men + children)?
questions.trap: Counting duplicate Visit IDs inflates the total reached.

questions.question: Normalise village names by trimming outer whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace and comparing case-insensitively; deduplicate Visit ID by keeping its first spreadsheet occurrence. How many women were reached by Health & Nutrition visits in Odisha?
questions.trap: Summing all Odisha attendees or retaining resubmitted visits is wrong.

questions.question: Normalise village names by trimming outer whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace and comparing case-insensitively; deduplicate Visit ID by keeping its first spreadsheet occurrence. How many distinct retained visits took place in Gadchiroli district?
questions.trap: Spreadsheet row count includes duplicate Visit IDs and blank separators.

questions.question: Normalise village names by trimming outer whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace and comparing case-insensitively; deduplicate Visit ID by keeping its first spreadsheet occurrence. Which village reached the most people in total? Report the normalised village in title case.
questions.trap: Case and spacing variants otherwise split one village into several groups.

questions.question: Normalise village names by trimming outer whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace and comparing case-insensitively; deduplicate Visit ID by keeping its first spreadsheet occurrence. What percentage of retained visits require follow-up? Round to two decimal places.
questions.trap: Using raw rows as the denominator gives duplicates extra weight.

questions.question: Normalise village names by trimming outer whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace and comparing case-insensitively; deduplicate Visit ID by keeping its first spreadsheet occurrence. Treat numeric and ₹/comma-formatted travel cells as INR. What was the total travel reimbursement for Water Security visits in Maharashtra?
questions.trap: Text-formatted INR cells are easily dropped, and duplicate visits are easily counted twice.
